component.name: Prism Monitor
component.summary: Fast native system monitor for Linux

description.p: Prism Monitor is a lightweight, native system monitor built with GTK 4, Cairo and Pango. It renders live telemetry with custom visualizations while keeping its own CPU footprint low.

ul.li: Overview, CPU, memory, GPU, storage, network, processes, sensors and power
Services, startup entries, network connections and installed applications
Drives, disk space analysis, benchmarks, power and session recording

description.p: Deep settings cover themes, accents, fonts, language, temperature units, graph history, smoothing, visual quality, animation and popout behavior.

Command line with headless JSON snapshot and TSV recording, pause/resume sampling, threshold alerts, Ctrl+K command palette, snapshot/recording export to JSON/CSV, and restored window size and last page.
Appearance now opens a dedicated theme and accent panel, the sidebar can be collapsed to an icon rail, and packaging metadata is current.
First stable release with 18 monitoring and management pages.
